_help: Day 2, room 1: the kitchen, 'Breakfast for two' (1990s-2001). The year they met on the old calendar; Henri's coffee by the harbour photo and the kitchen clock. See docs/STORY.md.

locks._why: The key to the hall was behind the kitchen clock.
hints: The way to the coats and hats is still locked.
The key from the kitchen clock opens the door to the hall.
Select the brass key, then tap the door to the hall.

locks._why: Henri's favourite crossword clue was the year they met, and 'he looked at the old calendar anyway': the calendar is from 1957.
hints: Henri always checked one thing on the wall before answering.
The year on the old calendar belongs to the kitchen drawers.

locks._why: The tiny key from the drawers opens the left cupboard.
hints: A tiny key and a cupboard of good plates.
The tiny key fits the left cupboard.
Select the tiny key, then tap the left cupboard.

locks._why: Coffee at six, poured one minute per boat gone out in the harbour photo (5): five past six on the kitchen clock.
hints: How long did Henri wait before pouring? Count what he counted.
The boats in the harbour photo and the kitchen clock go together.
Six o'clock plus a minute for each of the 5 boats: five past six.

locks._why: Something rolled into the gap under the island; only Chloé fits.
hints: Something rolled where the crumbs go.
Chloé can fetch from under the kitchen island.
Tap Chloé, then tap the gap under the island.

locks._why: Chloé waits by her empty bowl; her breakfast was in the left cupboard. Fed, she drops a memory.
hints: Chloé keeps glancing at her bowl.
She's hungry, and the kibble was in the left cupboard.
Select the kibble, then tap Chloé.

clues.text: An old calendar, kept for its picture of the beach at sunrise. The year is printed at the top: 1957.
A photo of the harbour at dawn, boats going out.
